UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores a user's professional background, role, department, and specific job description for quality audit contextualization.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the user owner.

displayName.description: Full name or display name of the employee.

jobRole.description: User's official role or title in the company.

department.description: Department or business unit within the organization.

jobDescription.description: Detailed description of specific functions, daily responsibilities, and operational scope.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

AuditInteraction.title: AuditInteraction
AuditInteraction.description: Represents a single quality audit exchange entry containing the user's input (process, challenge, complaint, or suggestion) and Gemini's structured audit response.

userId.description: Immutable UID of the user who owns this interaction.

sessionId.description: Identifier grouping multi-turn exchanges into a conversation thread.

category.description: Primary focus of the exchange turn.

userPrompt.description: The user's raw message describing their process, challenge, complaint, or idea.

aiResponse.description: Conversational response and reflection generated by Gemini 3.6 Flash.

executiveSummary.description: Concise audit summary of the user's input and operational impact.

brainstormingIdeas.description: Actionable brainstorming recommendations and process improvements.

auditAlignment.description: Assessment of how this entry aligns with uploaded company audit basis standards.

severityLevel.description: Assessed operational risk or priority level.

userRoleSnapshot.description: Snapshot of the user's role and department at the time of the audit entry.

userNameSnapshot.description: Snapshot of the user's display name for Super Admin audit reporting.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp of the interaction.

CompanyAuditDocument.title: CompanyAuditDocument
CompanyAuditDocument.description: Company information, SOPs, and quality audit basis uploaded by the Super Administrator.

authorUid.description: UID of the Super Admin who uploaded the document.

title.description: Title of the company policy, SOP, or audit framework document.

content.description: Full text content used by Gemini as the authoritative basis for quality audits.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was last modified.

/users/{userId}.description: User professional background profiles isolated by userId, readable by owner or Super Admin.

/users/{userId}/interactions/{interactio.description: User-isolated multi-turn quality audit interactions and Gemini insights, readable by owner or Super Admin.

/company_docs/{docId}.description: Company information and quality audit basis documents managed exclusively by the Super Admin and read by authenticated users.
